name: MBSF 27 CCW and 30 CCW Chronic Conditions files
description: The CCW Chronic Conditions datasets provide beneficiary-level indicators of chronic conditions derived from Medicare fee-for-service (FFS) claims using standardized CMS CCW algorithms. The CCW has two versions: (a) the 27 CCW Chronic Conditions (2003-2016; named MBSF_CC_YYYY) and (b) the 30 CCW Chronic Conditions (2017-2022; named MBSF_CHRONIC_YYYY). Key elements include the Ever/First Occurrence Date — the date the beneficiary first met the clinical FFS claims criteria of the algorithm (no coverage criteria applied) and Annual Indicators (codes 0–3) reflecting condition criteria and FFS coverage sufficiency. Both versions include all Medicare beneficiaries, with no age or coverage restrictions.
